findings.title: CronJob is suspended
findings.cause: CronJob report is suspended (spec.suspend: true), so its schedule "* * * * *" starts no Jobs; it has never started one

evidence.command: kubectl get cronjob report -n kd-cronjob-suspended -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend}{" "}{.status.lastScheduleTime}'

findings.fix: Resume it if it should run: kubectl patch cronjob report -n kd-cronjob-suspended --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}'. Runs missed while it was suspended are not started, unless startingDeadlineSeconds still covers them.
